answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Sounding Line at Sludge Spinner, spending 6 Charge for 12 damage and Hydro, then played Water's Edge at Sludge Spinner for 6 damage and Hydro. This used both energy, left the enemy at 16 HP, and I would take the telegraphed 8 damage, ending at 40 HP.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Sounding Line plus Coral Guard: the same 12 damage and Hydro, but 5 Block instead of Water's Edge's 6 damage, reducing the incoming 8 to 3 damage. Gyorin Formation was a secondary defensive alternative, but it gave up all damage.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 Block from Coral Guard and the 3 HP that block would have prevented, and it also passed on Gyorin Formation's 10 Block now and 6 Block at the start of next turn. It spent 6 Charge, leaving only 2 Charge.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If the intent had been a much larger or lethal attack, I would likely have shifted to Gyorin Formation or Sounding Line plus Coral Guard. If the intent had been weak or non-attacking, the damage line would have been even more attractive.
